id./param/scenario/cs/c_040_cs_010.pack|cs_: "...Wait.

"{var:1}... give me a moment.
  I have something to say to Jade.

"Heliodor... strong and beautiful.
  It never wavered in Mordegon's grasp.
  Jade... I put you through hardship...

"...Why did I not stay by your side
  on that day sixteen years ago...

"Sixteen years lost, my heart devoured by
  Mordegon. I couldn't even imagine my
  beloved daughter growing up...!

"I can never repent enough
  for my weakness then...!

"You should have lived as a princess of this
  kingdom, knowing nothing of battle,
  in peace and happiness.

"You've fought enough. It isn't too late
  to live as Heliodor's princess now,
  you know?
"Father...

"...Father. Jade has never once
  regretted these sixteen years.

"For sixteen years, Jade has journeyed
  in search of something to protect.

"...There was much hardship.
  There were times I pitied my own fate.

"But at the end of those days, I found
  something irreplaceable and dear.

"Father, Rab, my beloved homeland,
  gentle people and trusted allies...
  and all of Erdrea, where they all live.

"I found what I must protect.
  ...Not for anyone else. I fight
  to protect what I hold dear.
"...Jade... you've grown strong.

"I meant to give you this on the day you
  became queen, but it seems
  now is the time. Please take it.

"It's a golden tiara, once your late
  mother's. It will surely suit
  your black hair.

"Mother's tiara... I'll treasure it.
  Thank you, Father.

"Now, Jade, off you go. When all is over
  and peace has come, let's live together
  in this Heliodor.

"...Yes!
  I'll be going, Father!
